# June heat in the shaded bed

The shaded bed retained moisture while the sunny pots needed water twice a day. I moved two pots rather than extending the hose. Different positions make any yield comparison messy, but the immediate objective is surviving the week. [[Garden notebook]]: an intervention can be reasonable without creating a clean experiment. Leave the unused automatic timer in its box until we understand the problem.
